correctness.rationale: The nonsingular affine normalization maps three consecutive vertices to (0,0),(1,0),(0,1); fourth (p,q) has p,q>0,p+q>1. For fixed X, admissible four-vertex barycentric vectors form a segment; maxima of coordinate weights occur at a triangle-representation endpoint. The two diagonals divide Q into four sectors, each with exactly two available triangle triples. Verified the supplied six linear barycentric coefficients for the A/B sectors algebraically and the symmetry under p<->q. Comparing sharp active-coordinate lower bounds with explicit attaining points produces m_A/m_B and their swaps; minimization gives the four phase formulas, continuous at p=1, q=1, p+q=2. Independently set up all four sector LPs with six barycentric inequalities plus triangle-domain inequalities, used SciPy HiGHS on 200 random positive shape pairs satisfying p+q>1, and found agreement with the formula to <2e-8. The formula yields 1/3<lambda<=1/2 with equality p=q=1; scaling the Minkowski identity yields c=1/lambda-1. LP samples are corroboration, not the all-quadrilateral proof.
